name: @mcv/onboarding-sdk
description: MCV Onboarding primitives — prospect journey types, 12 reusable step definitions, 7 track compositions (investor_retail, investor_accredited, partner, creator, team_member, ally, waitlist), and track+venture→agent assignment rules. The journey orchestrator is DB-agnostic; API handlers do the writes. Phase 2 of the ecosystem build sequence.
